versions.changelog:
## Ore Abundance 1.0

First release.

- About 1.5 times as many ore veins in the Overworld: coal, copper, iron, gold, redstone, lapis lazuli, diamond and emerald.
- Vein attempts per chunk: coal 30 → 45 and 20 → 30, copper 16 → 24 (also the large veins of dripstone caves), iron 90 → 135, 10 → 15 and 10 → 15, gold 4 → 6 (badlands 50 → 75), redstone 4 → 6 and 8 → 12, lapis 2 → 3 and 4 → 6, diamond 7 → 10, 4 → 6 and 2 → 3, emerald 100 → 150. Large diamond veins: one in 6 chunks instead of one in 9.
- Vein sizes, heights and biomes stay vanilla; Nether ores do not change.
- Only land generated after the pack is added gets the extra ores; existing chunks do not change.

## Ore Abundance 1.1

The Nether update.

- Nether quartz and nether gold ore are now about 1.5 times as common, by the same rule as the Overworld ores.
- Vein attempts per chunk: Nether quartz 16 → 24 (basalt deltas 32 → 48), nether gold ore 10 → 15 (basalt deltas 20 → 30).
- Ancient debris stays vanilla on purpose: it is too valuable to multiply.
- Vein sizes and heights stay vanilla; all Overworld changes of 1.0 stay as they were.
- Only Nether land generated after the update gets the extra ores; existing chunks do not change.

## Ore Abundance 1.2

Amethyst geodes.

- Amethyst geodes are now about 1.5 times as common, by the same rule as the ores: one geode attempt every 16 chunks instead of every 24.
- Geode size, height (from 6 blocks above the bottom up to y 30) and contents stay vanilla, so budding amethyst stays as rare inside each geode as before.
- All ore changes of 1.0 and 1.1 stay as they were.
- Only land generated after the update gets the extra geodes; existing chunks do not change.
- Works on Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3.
